summary.en: A Khmer port called Prey Nokor, settled by Vietnamese in the 17th century and organised as Gia Định in 1698. As Saigon it was the capital of French Cochinchina and of South Vietnam, and was renamed after Hồ Chí Minh in 1976.
summary.zh: 原为高棉港口波雷诺哥，17世纪越南移民迁入，1698年设嘉定府。以西贡之名先后作为法属交趾支那和南越的首府，1976年以胡志明之名命名。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Ho Chi Minh City
Keith W. Taylor, A History of the Vietnamese (Cambridge University Press, 2013)
David Chandler, A History of Cambodia (Westview, 4th ed. 2008)
Wikipedia: Ho Chi Minh City

note: The start of Vietnamese settlement and the date of the Khmer name are approximate.

polity.zh: 唐安南都护府 / 地方自主政权
阮朝 / 法属印度支那

summary.en: On the Red River, the Tang citadel of Đại La became Thăng Long when the Lý made it their capital in 1010. Renamed Hà Nội in 1831, it was the capital of French Indochina and has been Vietnam's capital since 1945.
summary.zh: 红河畔的唐代大罗城于1010年被李朝定为都城，改名升龙。1831年改称河内，曾为法属印度支那首府，1945年起为越南首都。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Hanoi
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Central Sector of the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long – Hanoi
Keith W. Taylor, A History of the Vietnamese (Cambridge University Press, 2013)
Wikipedia: Hanoi

note: Hanoi was also capital of French Indochina from 1902.

polity.zh: 荷兰东印度公司 / 荷属东印度

summary.en: The pepper port of Sunda Kelapa was taken by Fatahillah in 1527 and renamed Jayakarta. The Dutch rebuilt it as Batavia in 1619; renamed Jakarta during the Japanese occupation, it became the capital of independent Indonesia.
summary.zh: 胡椒港口巽他格拉巴于1527年被法塔希拉攻占并改名查雅加达。1619年荷兰人在此重建巴达维亚；日本占领期间改称雅加达，后成为独立的印度尼西亚首都。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Jakarta
M. C. Ricklefs, A History of Modern Indonesia since c. 1200 (Palgrave, 4th ed. 2008)
Nicholas Tarling (ed.), The Cambridge History of Southeast Asia, Vol. 1: From Early Times to c. 1800 (1992)
Wikipedia: Jakarta

note: The start of Sunda Kelapa as a port is approximate; Wikidata dates the city's founding to 22 June 1527.

polity.zh: 孟族王国 / 东吁王朝

summary.en: A Mon town around the Shwedagon Pagoda, Dagon was renamed Yangon ("end of strife") by Alaungpaya in 1755. Under British rule Rangoon became the capital of Burma, which it remained until the government moved to Naypyidaw in 2005.
summary.zh: 大光原为瑞德宫大金塔周围的孟族城镇，1755年雍籍牙将其改名仰光（意为“战争终结”）。英国统治时期仰光成为缅甸首府，直至2005年政府迁往内比都。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Yangon
G. E. Harvey, History of Burma (Longmans, 1925)
Victor Lieberman, Strange Parallels: Southeast Asia in Global Context, c. 800–1830, Vol. 1 (Cambridge University Press, 2003)
Wikipedia: Yangon

note: Wikidata's founding date of 1035 is traditional; 1000 is used as an approximate start.

summary.en: A riverside customs and fort town on the Chao Phraya under Ayutthaya, it became the capital when Taksin settled at Thonburi in 1767 and Rama I founded the new royal city on the east bank in 1782.
summary.zh: 阿瑜陀耶时期湄南河畔的关卡与要塞小镇。1767年郑信定都吞武里，1782年拉玛一世在东岸建立新王城，曼谷由此成为都城。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Bangkok
Chris Baker & Pasuk Phongpaichit, A History of Thailand (Cambridge University Press, 2nd ed. 2009)
David K. Wyatt, Thailand: A Short History (Yale University Press, 2nd ed. 2003)
Wikipedia: Bangkok

note: The date of the early settlement is approximate.

polity.zh: 菲律宾（法定首都为奎松城）

summary.en: A fortified Muslim trading settlement on Manila Bay, Maynila was taken by Legazpi, who founded the Spanish city in 1571. It was the hub of the trans-Pacific galleon trade and has been the Philippine capital except in 1948–1976, when Quezon City held the title.
summary.zh: 马尼拉湾畔设防的穆斯林贸易聚落，被黎牙实比攻取后于1571年建立西班牙城市。这里是跨太平洋大帆船贸易的枢纽，除1948—1976年奎松城为法定首都外，一直是菲律宾首都。

sources.title: Emma H. Blair & James A. Robertson (eds.), The Philippine Islands, 1493–1898, Vol. 3 (1903)
Nicholas Tarling (ed.), The Cambridge History of Southeast Asia, Vol. 1: From Early Times to c. 1800 (1992)
Wikipedia: Manila
Philippine News Agency/PTV: How QC became biggest LGU in Metro Manila (RA 333 of 1948; PD 940 of 1976)

note: The pre-Hispanic polity's origins are not precisely dated. Republic Act 333 (1948) made Quezon City the capital; Presidential Decree 940 (1976) restored Manila.

polity.zh: 马来亚联合邦；1963年起为马来西亚

summary.en: Founded by Parameswara around 1400, Malacca controlled the strait that bears its name and was the region's richest port. It passed to the Portuguese (1511), Dutch (1641) and British (1824), leaving a layered colonial townscape.
summary.zh: 马六甲约于1400年由拜里米苏拉建立，控制着以其命名的海峡，是区域最富庶的港口。此后相继归属葡萄牙（1511年）、荷兰（1641年）与英国（1824年），留下层叠的殖民城市风貌。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Melaka and George Town, Historic Cities of the Straits of Malacca
Barbara Watson Andaya & Leonard Y. Andaya, A History of Malaysia (Palgrave, 3rd ed. 2017)
Wikipedia: Malacca City

note: British occupation 1795–1818 during the Napoleonic Wars is merged into the Dutch period.

summary.en: Named after the hill temple founded, by legend, by Lady Penh in 1372, the site at the confluence of the Mekong and Tonlé Sap became the Khmer capital after Angkor's abandonment and again under King Norodom in 1865.
summary.zh: 其名源于传说中奔夫人于1372年在山丘上建造的寺庙。此地位于湄公河与洞里萨河交汇处，吴哥被放弃后成为高棉都城，1865年诺罗敦国王再度定都于此。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Phnom Penh
David Chandler, A History of Cambodia (Westview, 4th ed. 2008)
George Cœdès, The Indianized States of Southeast Asia (University of Hawaii Press, 1968)
Wikipedia: Phnom Penh

note: The 1372 founding and Ponhea Yat's capital dates are traditional.

summary.en: Yasovarman I founded Yasodharapura around 889, and for five centuries the Angkor region was the heart of the Khmer Empire. After 1431 the court moved south, though Angkor Wat remained a pilgrimage centre; Siam returned the province to French Cambodia in 1907.
summary.zh: 耶输跋摩一世约于889年建立耶输陀罗补罗，此后五个世纪里吴哥地区一直是高棉帝国的中心。1431年后王廷南迁，吴哥窟仍为朝圣之地；1907年暹罗将该省归还法属柬埔寨。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Angkor (Siem Reap)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Angkor
George Cœdès, The Indianized States of Southeast Asia (University of Hawaii Press, 1968)
Wikipedia: Angkor

note: The capital moved between Angkor and nearby sites (e.g. Koh Ker, 928–944).

summary.en: Capital of the first Burmese empire, whose rulers and subjects built over 10,000 Buddhist temples and stupas on the plain beside the Irrawaddy between the 11th and 13th centuries; more than 2,000 survive.
summary.zh: 缅甸第一个帝国的都城。11至13世纪间，君主与臣民在伊洛瓦底江畔的平原上建造了一万多座佛寺与佛塔，现存两千余座。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Bagan
Michael Aung-Thwin, Pagan: The Origins of Modern Burma (University of Hawaii Press, 1985)
Wikipedia: Bagan

polity.zh: 马六甲苏丹国，后为柔佛

polity.en: British: East India Company, then Straits Settlements
polity.zh: 英国：东印度公司，后为海峡殖民地

summary.en: Known to 14th-century Chinese traders as Danmaxi (Temasek), it took the Sanskrit name Singapura, "lion city". Raffles founded a British port here in 1819; Japan renamed it Syonan-to, "light of the south", in 1942. It left Malaysia to become independent in 1965.
summary.zh: 14世纪中国商人称之为“单马锡”（淡马锡），后得梵语名“新加坡拉”，意为“狮城”。1819年莱佛士在此建立英国港口；1942年日本改名“昭南岛”。1965年脱离马来西亚独立。

sources.title: Wang Dayuan, Daoyi zhilüe (Brief Account of the Island Barbarians, 1349)
C. M. Turnbull, A History of Modern Singapore 1819–2005 (NUS Press, 2009)
John N. Miksic, Singapore and the Silk Road of the Sea, 1300–1800 (NUS Press, 2013)
Wikipedia: Singapore

note: The 14th-century kingdom of Singapura is known from the Malay Annals and archaeology; its dates are approximate.

polity.en: Đại Việt (Trần, Lê; Nguyễn lords from 1558)
polity.zh: 大越（陈朝、后黎朝；1558年起阮主）

summary.en: Champa ceded the districts of Ô and Lý to Đại Việt in 1306 as the dowry of a Trần princess; they became Thuận and Hóa, the likely origin of the name Huế. As Phú Xuân it was the Nguyễn lords' seat, and from 1802 to 1945 the imperial capital of the Nguyễn emperors.
summary.zh: 1306年占城以乌、里二州作为迎娶陈朝公主的聘礼割让给大越，改称顺州、化州，“顺化”之名很可能由此而来。富春曾是阮主的治所，1802年至1945年为阮朝皇都。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Complex of Huế Monuments
Keith W. Taylor, A History of the Vietnamese (Cambridge University Press, 2013)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Hue
Wikipedia: Huế

note: The derivation of "Huế" from "Hóa" is the usual explanation but not certain.

polity.en: Kingdom of Luang Prabang (Siamese vassal from 1779)
polity.zh: 琅勃拉邦王国（1779年起为暹罗藩属）

polity.en: French Laos, then Kingdom of Laos (royal capital)
polity.zh: 法属老挝，后为老挝王国（王都）

summary.en: The first capital of Lan Xang, at the meeting of the Mekong and Nam Khan. It is named after the Phra Bang, a gold Buddha image installed here in the early 16th century, and stayed the royal seat of Laos until the monarchy was abolished in 1975.
summary.zh: 澜沧王国的首都，位于湄公河与南康河交汇处。城名来自16世纪初供奉于此的勃拉邦金佛。在1975年君主制被废除之前，这里一直是老挝的王都。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Town of Luang Prabang
Martin Stuart-Fox, A History of Laos (Cambridge University Press, 1997)
Wikipedia: Luang Prabang

note: The date of the earliest Muang Sua and of the change to "Luang Prabang" (after the Phra Bang arrived c. 1512) are approximate.

summary.en: Viang Chan, "city of sandalwood", became Lan Xang's capital under Setthathirath in 1560. Siamese armies razed it after Anouvong's revolt in 1828; the French rebuilt it as the seat of their Laos administration, and it has been the national capital since.
summary.zh: 永珍意为“檀香之城”，1560年塞塔提拉王将澜沧都城迁至此地。1828年阿努冯起义失败后被暹罗军队夷为平地；法国人重建它作为老挝殖民政府驻地，此后一直是国家首都。

sources.title: Martin Stuart-Fox, A History of Laos (Cambridge University Press, 1997)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Vientiane
Wikipedia: Vientiane

note: French Laos was administered from Vientiane from 1899.

name.en: Nopburi Si Nakhon Ping Chiang Mai

summary.en: "New city", founded by Mangrai in 1296 with his allies Ngam Muang and Ram Khamhaeng. Burmese chronicles call it Zinme; after two centuries of Burmese rule it was half-abandoned, revived under Kawila in 1796 and absorbed into the Siamese provincial system in 1899.
summary.zh: “新城”，1296年由孟莱王与盟友昂孟、兰甘亨共同建立。缅甸史书称之为“景迈”；经过两个世纪的缅甸统治后一度半废，1796年在卡维拉王治下复兴，1899年并入暹罗的省制。

sources.title: David K. Wyatt & Aroonrut Wichienkeeo (trans.), The Chiang Mai Chronicle (Silkworm Books, 2nd ed. 1998)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Chiang Mai
Wikipedia: Chiang Mai

summary.en: Founded by King Mindon in 1857 at the foot of Mandalay Hill to fulfil a Buddhist prophecy, with a square moated palace city. It was the last royal capital of Burma: British troops entered in November 1885 and sent King Thibaw into exile.
summary.zh: 1857年敏东王为应验佛教预言，在曼德勒山下兴建此城，宫城呈方形并环以护城河。它是缅甸最后的王都：1885年11月英军入城，锡袍王被流放。

sources.title: Thant Myint-U, The River of Lost Footsteps: Histories of Burma (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2006)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Mandalay
Wikipedia: Mandalay

summary.en: An island city ringed by the Chao Phraya, Lopburi and Pa Sak rivers, named after Ayodhya, the city of Rama. For four centuries it was the capital of Siam and one of Asia's great trading ports, until the Burmese sack of 1767; Chinese sources call it Dacheng, the "great city".
summary.zh: 被湄南河、华富里河和巴塞河环绕的岛城，以罗摩之城阿约提亚命名。四个世纪里它是暹罗首都和亚洲大贸易港之一，直到1767年被缅军攻陷焚毁。华人称之为“大城”。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Historic City of Ayutthaya
Chris Baker & Pasuk Phongpaichit, A History of Ayutthaya (Cambridge University Press, 2017)
Wikipedia: Ayutthaya (city)

note: A settlement called Ayothaya predates the 1351 founding; its date is approximate.

polity.zh: 海峡殖民地（1832年前为首府）

polity.en: Malayan Union, then Federation of Malaya
polity.zh: 马来亚联邦，后为马来亚联合邦
马来亚联合邦（槟城州首府）

summary.en: Francis Light landed on Pulau Pinang, "betel-nut island", in 1786 under a disputed deal with the Sultan of Kedah and named the settlement after George III. Its shophouses, clan temples and mosques make it, with Malacca, a World Heritage site of the Straits trading towns.
summary.zh: 1786年弗朗西斯·莱特依据与吉打苏丹一项有争议的协议登上槟榔屿，以英王乔治三世之名命名该定居点。城内的店屋、宗祠和清真寺使它与马六甲一起列入世界遗产，代表马六甲海峡的贸易城镇。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Melaka and George Town, Historic Cities of the Straits of Malacca
Barbara Watson Andaya & Leonard Y. Andaya, A History of Malaysia (Palgrave, 3rd ed. 2017)
Wikipedia: George Town, Penang

note: The start of the Malay name entry is approximate.

summary.en: The deep-water bay south of the Hải Vân Pass where a Franco-Spanish fleet opened the conquest of Vietnam in 1858. Under the French it was the concession of Tourane; in 1965 the first US combat Marines came ashore here, and it became one of the largest air bases of the Vietnam War.
summary.zh: 海云关以南的深水港湾，1858年法西联合舰队在此揭开征服越南的序幕。法国统治时期为土伦租借地；1965年首批美国作战陆战队在此登陆，这里成为越战中最大的空军基地之一。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Da Nang
Keith W. Taylor, A History of the Vietnamese (Cambridge University Press, 2013)
Wikipedia: Da Nang

note: Start date of the Vietnamese port name is approximate; the area was Cham until the 15th century.

polity.zh: 荷兰东印度公司，后为荷属东印度

summary.en: The port of the Gowa–Tallo sultanate, which welcomed all traders and defied the VOC's spice monopoly until the Makassar War of 1666–1669. The Dutch rebuilt its fort as Fort Rotterdam. Renamed Ujung Pandang after a local cape in 1971, it took back its old name in 1999.
summary.zh: 戈瓦—塔洛苏丹国的港口，向各国商人开放，并对抗荷兰东印度公司的香料垄断，直到1666—1669年望加锡战争。荷兰人将其城堡改建为鹿特丹堡。1971年以当地岬角之名改称乌戎潘当，1999年恢复旧名。

sources.title: Leonard Y. Andaya, The Heritage of Arung Palakka (Martinus Nijhoff, 1981)
M. C. Ricklefs, A History of Modern Indonesia since c. 1200 (4th ed., Stanford University Press, 2008)
Wikipedia: Makassar

note: The start date of the Gowa port is approximate.

polity.zh: 联合国东帝汶过渡行政当局

summary.en: The Portuguese moved the capital of Timor here from Lifau in 1769 to escape attacks by rival local lords. Indonesian troops invaded on 7 December 1975; after the 1999 referendum militias burned much of the town, and it became the capital of independent Timor-Leste in 2002.
summary.zh: 1769年葡萄牙人为躲避当地敌对势力的攻击，将帝汶首府从利福迁到这里。1975年12月7日印尼军队入侵；1999年公投后民兵焚毁了大半个城市，2002年它成为独立的东帝汶首都。

sources.title: Geoffrey C. Gunn, History of Timor (Centro de Estudos sobre África e do Desenvolvimento, Lisbon, 1999)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Dili
Wikipedia: Dili

name.en: Villa del Santísimo Nombre de Jesús
Cebu (Ciudad del Santísimo Nombre de Jesús)

polity.zh: 菲律宾革命，后为美国统治

summary.en: The trading port of Rajah Humabon, where Magellan baptised the ruler in 1521. Legazpi founded the first Spanish town in the islands here in 1565, and the Santo Niño image left by Magellan's expedition is still venerated in its basilica.
summary.zh: 拉者胡马邦的贸易港，1521年麦哲伦在此为其施洗。1565年黎牙实比在此建立西班牙在群岛上的第一个城镇；麦哲伦船队留下的圣婴像至今仍供奉在当地圣殿中。

sources.title: Antonio Pigafetta, Relazione del primo viaggio intorno al mondo (1524)
Teodoro A. Agoncillo, History of the Filipino People (8th ed., Garotech, 1990)
Wikipedia: Cebu City

note: The start date of Sugbu as a port polity is approximate.
